author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: Send key now offers only the keys Glasshouse accepts, including Channel up and Channel down. New optional API token setting. New healthStatus attribute, and the 'reachable again' line says how long the TV was unreachable. The driver runs single-threaded, and ARC volume steps log at debug. Debug logging now turns itself off after 30 minutes, and a new descriptionText logging option (on by default) logs value changes. The Notifier's version now matches the TV driver. After updating, click Initialize on the TV device. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
